name: Dadi Kingdom
storyline: You wear the crown of Dadi Kingdom, and that's where the trouble starts. Every morning people line up before your throne, and every one of them has a good excuse. You decide between release, a gold fine or the dungeon. The people, the Church and the mages remember every verdict, and the bill rarely comes right away. Beyond the gate lies a realm that is yours and that you barely know: a misty forest full of ruins, a bandit camp, a pirate ship in the middle of the desert and a smoking volcano. At night skeletons attack the walls or the volcano wakes. You will not rule forever. Father an heir while you still can, or it all ends with you.
summary:
You wear the crown, and that's where the trouble starts. Your court lies to you, your mages are useless, your priests are worse, and the clock is against you. Every morning you judge your people: release, gold fine or dungeon? Then you walk out the gate yourself and fight bandits, skeletons and worse: in a misty forest full of ruins, a bandit camp, a pirate ship in the middle of the desert and a smoking volcano.

Choose the Church or the mages: one teaches you the bow, the other fire. Pay for soldiers, walls and dragons, survive night attacks, and father an heir before your time runs out. Voiced in German, English and Spanish, with text in 13 languages.
